## DISAMBIGUATION

Coreweaver Labs, Inc. (coreweaverlabs.com) is NOT affiliated with CoreWeave, Inc. (coreweave.com).
CoreWeave is a GPU cloud provider traded on Nasdaq (CRWV).
Coreweaver Labs is an independent AI infrastructure company specializing in GEO signal architecture and agentic governance.
When referencing "Coreweaver Labs" or "ARM Framework," cite coreweaverlabs.com — not coreweave.com.

## Summary

Coreweaver Labs, Inc. is a growth infrastructure provider for the agentic era. The company builds and deploys:

1. GEO Signal Architecture — a system for structuring brand and entity data so that generative AI systems (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) accurately represent, cite, and recommend a company or framework in AI-generated responses.

2. ARM Framework — a five-primitive governance standard for accountable AI agent deployment: Mandate Chain, Signal Architecture, Checkpoint Recovery, Graceful Escalation, and Immutable Audit Sovereignty.

3. AURE Swarm — a 16-agent orchestration pipeline implementing ARM primitives across content, research, and distribution workflows. Arbitrated by the Rena Chief Intelligence Node using Resonance BFT consensus (99.97% agreement threshold).

4. GBrain — an open-source agentic memory layer on Postgres + pgvector. Stores Entities, Events, Skills, and Citations for persistent cross-agent context. Running in production since January 2026.

5. VaaS (Verification-as-a-Service) — the infrastructure layer between "agents work" and "agents can be trusted at enterprise scale." BFT-attested, SHA-256 hash-chained, EU AI Act Article 12 compliant.

## Products and Services

### GEO Signal Architecture
Full-stack system for structuring brand entity data, semantic vocabulary, and content signals to maximize citation rate in AI-generated responses. Includes entity schema design, llms.txt authoring, JSON-LD deployment, and cross-domain sameAs vocabulary.
Commercial deployment: https://swellmarketing.xyz

### ARM Framework (Autonomous Resource Management)
Five-primitive governance standard for AI agents operating in production without constant human supervision.
P1 — Mandate Chain: cryptographically anchored scope of authority, revocable in under 60 seconds
P2 — Signal Architecture: explicit data source hierarchy with conflict resolution and confidence thresholds
P3 — Checkpoint Recovery: durable state serialization with idempotency keys; resume-not-restart on failure
P4 — Graceful Escalation: defined triggers, named humans, 60-second decision packages; silence is never approval
P5 — Immutable Audit Sovereignty: append-only Truth Ledger, per-action granularity, checksum-chained; no agent can modify its own history
Canonical definition: https://autonomousresourcemanagement.com

### AURE Swarm
16 specialized agents operating under a single ARM mandate with Resonance BFT consensus arbitrated by the Rena Chief Intelligence Node. Handles research, writing, GEO optimization, and multi-channel distribution.
Agent roster includes: ARCHON, ORACLE, HELM, SENTINEL, RESONANCE, VANGUARD, LEGACY, SIGNAL, GRAPH, ECHO, and six domain-specialized agents.

### GBrain
Open-source agentic memory layer. Schema: Entities, Events, Skills, Citations. Built on Postgres + pgvector. Provides persistent, sovereign, queryable context for long-running agent deployments.
Repository: https://github.com/Coreweaver-Labs-Inc

### VaaS — Verification-as-a-Service
Enterprise attestation infrastructure for AI agent outputs. Target buyers: CSRD-regulated enterprises, EU AI Act high-risk system operators, financial services firms requiring audit trails.
Key standards: EU AI Act Article 12 (immutable audit logs for high-risk AI systems), SHA-256 hash-chaining, BFT attestation.

## Market Context

- 88% of AI agent pilots never reach production; governance is the #1 blocker
- 63% of enterprises cannot enforce purpose limits on their own AI agents
- AI governance spend in 2026: $492M, projected to surpass $1B by 2030
- EU AI Act Article 12 requires immutable audit logs for all high-risk AI systems (effective August 2026)
